thread:
incidents-bot: Paging: GPU pool 'eu-west-2-gpu-pool' high queue length detected > 95% for 3m. Impact: request throttling observed. Please acknowledge with /ack.

alice (oncall-sre): acked, looking. seeing queue growth on pool 3, tails climbing.

ben (oncall-ml): on it. any recent rollout? i see a vnext model push around 2301234400 in deploy history.

deploy-bot: Deploy v15.2.0 to eu-west-2 completed at 2301234398 by ci/cd.

carmen (sre-lead): good catch. ben, does v15 change context handling or kv caching?

ben (oncall-ml): yes — v15 enabled an aggressive kv_cache prefetch for long contexts (up to 64k ctx) and did some tokenization tweaks. should reduce io but increases KV footprint per session.

dinesh (infra): that matches metrics — KV-cache memory per session jumped ~3x after 2301234400. autoscaler tried to add nodes but hit per-region quota and allocation latency spiked.

alice (oncall-sre): visible symptoms: queue depth -> 1200, 95p latency > 5s, per-node OOM-ish eviction chatter in logs. requests getting parked, then 429.

jamie (support): receiving customer complaints: several production customers seeing higher latency and occasional 429s on generation. CX tickets are opening.

maria (cust-succ): heads-up: two enterprise customers are flagged as P1. I'll message them with status.

ben (oncall-ml): immediate mitigation idea: rollback kv prefetch flag or temporarily pin traffic to v14 variant. two quick levers: 1) rollout rollback 2) routing rule to route new sessions to v14. which is faster?

alice (oncall-sre): routing change is fastest (no model redeploy). we can create a routing override to prefer v14 for api keys matching production. i can patch routing in 3-5 mins.

dinesh (infra): autoscaler is also blocked by soft GPU quota in eu-west-2. i can request burst from cloud but ETA ~15-25m. meanwhile we can spin up small spare pool in eu-central with lower latency to some customers, but needs network ACL work.

carmen (sre-lead): short term: apply routing override + reduce kv_cache prefetch on hot nodes if possible. ben, can we flip a runtime flag per node rather than redeploy?

ben (oncall-ml): we have a runtime feature flag `kv_prefetch_enabled` controlled via config manager. flipping it on serving nodes is a config reload — safe. but must be targeted to eu-west-2 serving fleet to reduce footprint.

alice (oncall-sre): ok plan: 1) apply routing override to send new sessions to v14 (alice) 2) flip kv_prefetch_enabled=false for eu-west-2 serving (ben) 3) monitor queue/latency (alice/carmen) 4) request cloud burst (dinesh) 5) update customers (maria/jamie).

ben (oncall-ml): starting config rollout to EU serving. flipping flag on staging first.

alice (oncall-sre): making routing override now: `rbacctl set-route --region eu-west-2 --from model:v15 --to model:v14 --match session.new:true`

deploy-bot: Routing rule applied by alice at 2301234521.

ben (oncall-ml): flipping flag on 10% of nodes to verify: `cfgctl set kv_prefetch_enabled=false --scope eu-west-2 --percent 10`

alice (oncall-sre): queue depth down to 730, 95p latency down to 2.1s. some improvement.

jamie (support): sending preliminary note to affected customers: "We're investigating elevated latencies and 429s in eu-west-2. Mitigations in progress, will update in 15m."

maria (cust-succ): pinged P1 accounts directly and offered to divert traffic to alternate region if they want immediate SLA-safe failover.

ben (oncall-ml): rolling flag to 60% now. no errors on validation.

alice (oncall-sre): queue depth 210, 95p latency 800ms. throttles decreased ~85%. good.

dinesh (infra): cloud approved temporary burst of 4x GPUs; provisioning started (region quota patch). ETA 12m.

carmen (sre-lead): good progress. we should still prepare a rollback of v15 if we see repeat regressions when kv cache warms. ben, can you start a canary rollback job?

ben (oncall-ml): canary rollback prepared (no deploy yet) — `deploy rollback v14` job queued. will hold off until we confirm sustained improvement.

alice (oncall-sre): watch: some nodes showing high KV eviction rates even after flag flip — presumably sessions that warmed earlier still hold state. eviction is delaying GC. we may need to recycle a subset of hot nodes to free memory quickly.

dinesh (infra): i can orchestrate a rolling recycle of the 20 hottest nodes with `poolctl recycle --pool eu-west-2 --filter hot:true --parallel 5`. will preserve capacity by staggering.

ben (oncall-ml): note: recycling will drop KV warmups and might cause higher initial latency for those sessions but should free node memory and reduce systemic queue.

alice (oncall-sre): do recycle. initiating now.

deploy-bot: Pool recycle started by dinesh at 2301234640.

alice (oncall-sre): after recycle and flag roll, queue depth under 50, 95p latency 220ms, error rate normalized. routing overrides still in place.

jamie (support): updating customer message: "Mitigation applied — routing to stable model variant and node recycling performed. Monitoring shows errors and latency returning to normal. We'll follow up with a root cause update."

maria (cust-succ): customers acknowledged, one asked for postmortem and timeline. I told them we'll provide within 24h.

carmen (sre-lead): next actions for post-incident: 1) full rollback vs. bugfix decision (ben) 2) add autoscaler quota grace or pre-warm to reduce allocation latency (dinesh) 3) improve rollout canary for kv footprint (alice/product) 4) customer comms + postmortem (maria/jamie).

ben (oncall-ml): initial root cause: v15 introduced aggressive kv prefetch and tokenizer changes that increased per-session KV memory; during rollout, warm sessions inflated memory and autoscaler couldn't replenish fast due to quota/alloc delays leading to queue growth and throttling.

dinesh (infra): infra action: request permanent quota bump for eu-west-2 GPU pool, add soft reserve for high-priority customers, and implement faster cold start path for new instances.

alice (oncall-sre): SLO impact: about 18 minutes of elevated errors/latency for ~6% of requests in eu-west-2. blocked customers flagged P1 were impacted intermittently.

carmen (sre-lead): i'm closing paging now. please file postmortem ticket and link alert logs, deploy diff, and the routing change. assign to ben/alice/dinesh.

incidents-bot: Paging closed by carmen at 2301234888.

ben (oncall-ml): filing root cause ticket: https://pm.redwood/INC-230123-kvpressure (will attach logs and timeline).

alice (oncall-sre): I'm adding short-term guardrails: block v15 rollout for >5% of traffic until we run a KV-footprint test harness.

maria (cust-succ): I'll coordinate the customer postmortem and propose a remediation timeline for fixes and compensation if needed.

jamie (support): closing customer-facing updates channel. will reopen if we see regression. :thumbsup:

carmen (sre-lead): thanks team. lesson: runtime feature flags + routing overrides saved the day. add an item to improve rollout gating for memory/kvcache effects.

ben (oncall-ml): agreed. will roll the fix and smarter canary by EOD.

alice (oncall-sre): leaving notes in the incident ticket about the exact commands used and KPIs during mitigation.

dinesh (infra): will follow up on quota bump request and autoscaler tuning.

maria (cust-succ): posting summary to customers in 1h.

incidents-bot: Thread archived at 2301234888.
